summary: This document serves as the primary technical reference and runbook for configuring and testing ClankerLog hook integrations across various AI coding agents.
responsibilities: Documents CLI setup for hooking into Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Hermes, Topchester, Pi, and OpenClaw.
Defines sample JSON/YAML input payloads sent by agents to ClankerLog CLI on stdin.
Specifies cross-agent normalization rules for workspace and model metadata.
Provides instructions for local development using shim commands and troubleshooting via diagnostic CLI flags.
Outlines integration safety constraints, specifically excluding transcript, diff, and prompt collection.
